RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the appointed candidate are women, so an all-female panel provides no indication of sex discrimination. In appointments for a laboratory director, healthcare institutions frequently prioritize formal management training and broad operational leadership over higher academic research credentials like a PhD. 

Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded, adversarial, and detrimental to your professional reputation within the hospital network. Instead, send a polite, professional follow-up on your request for written feedback, framing it around identifying areas to strengthen your leadership profile for future senior administrative positions.
